ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, O is a point on line AB, and $\angle COD$ is a right angle. OE bisects $\angle BOD$, and OF bisects $\angle AOE$. If $\angle BOC=54^\circ$, what are the degrees of $\angle COE$ and $\angle DOF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle COD=90^\circ$ and $\angle BOC=54^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOD=90^\circ-54^\circ=36^\circ$,\\
Since OE bisects $\angle BOD$,\\
it follows that $\angle DOE=\angle BOE=18^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle COE=\angle BOC+\angle BOE=54^\circ+18^\circ=\boxed{72^\circ}$, $\angle AOE=180^\circ-\angle BOE=180^\circ-18^\circ=162^\circ$.\\
Since OF bisects $\angle AOE$,\\
it follows that $\angle EOF=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOE=81^\circ$\\
thus $\angle DOF=\angle EOF-\angle DOE=81^\circ-18^\circ=\boxed{63^\circ}$
